messages:
jane_customer: Hey team — applied promo code TRIAL-RED-50 during onboarding but the credit landed on our Hosted account (org: org_acme_123, product=hosted.api, sku=hosted-standard) instead of our Dedicated pool (org project: acme-dedicated, sku=dedicated-standard). We need the credit moved to the dedicated SKU so reserved capacity picks it up. Not urgent-critical but blocking our dedicated smoke tests.

sara: @jane_customer sorry about that — thanks for the details. Can you paste the promo code + any invoice/confirmation id? I’ll pull the billing log and see if this was auto-applied by the promo namespace.

jane_customer: Code is TRIAL-RED-50, confirmation id CONF-20240321-9X. No invoice yet, just the onboarding credit visible in Billing > Credits.

billing-bot: Promo TRIAL-RED-50 auto-applied -> credit_id=CR-0x1f2a3, applied_to=org_acme_123, product=hosted.api, sku=hosted-standard, amount=500.00 USD, applied_at=2024-11-22T18:34:02Z

sara: Thanks — looks like the promo namespace defaulted to hosted.api. Two options: 1) reassign the existing credit to the dedicated org/sku (manual operation, requires finance approval), or 2) issue a new credit scoped to the dedicated SKU and void the hosted one. Reassigning preserves the original code/amount which customers prefer.

mike: @sara looping finance. If the credit has already been consumed on hosted we cannot reassign it. @jane_customer can you confirm there’s been no consumption? Quick check: Billing > Usage shows 0 token usage against that credit id.

jane_customer: Confirmed — usage=0 for CR-0x1f2a3. We haven't spun up any production tests.

sara: Ok good. Internal repro steps for ops (for audit):
```
# internal billing CLI (ops only)
billing reassign-credit --credit-id CR-0x1f2a3 \\n  --from-org org_acme_123 --from-product hosted.api --from-sku hosted-standard \\n  --to-org org_acme_123_dedicated --to-product dedicated.api --to-sku dedicated-standard \\n  --reason "customer requested reassign: TRIAL-RED-50 applied to wrong product"
```

sara: I'll create an FIN ticket and request approval. @finance-ops can you triage? Ticket should include: credit id, amount, timestamps, and the customer's environment ID for the Dedicated pool.

finance-ops: Created FIN-9876 — request for manual credit reassign. Approvals needed: Billing Manager + Compliance. ETA ~ <24h if no blockers. Logged by sara.

mike: FYI this is low risk — no consumption and promo is valid for the account. Once finance approves ops can run the CLI reassign command (audit trail will record original promo code + new allocation).

sara: Next steps for the customer: I’ll follow up once FIN-9876 is approved and ops performs the reassign. Please avoid creating new Hosted resources that may consume the credit until we complete the move. I’ll post back here with the operation log.

jane_customer: Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. One question: will the promo code still show under Billing UI as TRIAL-RED-50 after reassign?

sara: Yes — the promo code metadata remains, but UI will show the credit now scoped to dedicated.api / dedicated-standard. We’ll include the new allocation id in the FIN ticket notes.

finance-ops: FIN-9876 approved by Billing Manager at 11:03 PT. ops may proceed.

billing-bot: Reassign operation scheduled -> op_id=OP-55221, executor=sara, started_at=2024-11-23T09:12:08Z

sara: Performed reassign. Command output: 
```
> billing reassign-credit --credit-id CR-0x1f2a3 --to-org org_acme_123_dedicated --to-sku dedicated-standard
status: SUCCESS
op_id: OP-55221
old_allocation: hosted.api / hosted-standard
new_allocation: dedicated.api / dedicated-standard
```

sara: @jane_customer can you confirm you see the credit under your Dedicated project now (Billing -> Credits -> filter: dedicated-standard)?

jane_customer: Checked — I see CR-0x1f2a3 under acme-dedicated, sku dedicated-standard. Verified amount 500.00 USD. Running smoke tests now.

jane_customer: Smoke tests passed. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

sara: Great! Closing FIN-9876 and marking this thread resolved. If anything else pops up ping eng-support or billing.

mike: Noted — will add a follow-up action to the onboarding flow to prevent defaulting promos to hosted when org has a dedicated pool, tracking as infra ticket INF-1312.

jane_customer: Awesome — thanks everyone!
